items.title: Procter & Gamble (PG) Appoints Shailesh Jejurikar As Chairman As Jon Moeller Retires
items.summary: Procter & Gamble (NYSE:PG) has appointed Shailesh Jejurikar as Chairman of the Board. The appointment will be effective from August 1, 2026. Current Executive Chairman Jon R. Moeller will retire from the Board as part of this transition. Jejurikar will continue in his roles as President and CEO alongside the new Chair position.
